title: Bodhisattva Path
speaker: Shuko Edie Norton
summary: Shuko Edie Norton closes the evening with housekeeping and no teaching. Shuko calls the sangha to page three of the chant book, notes that it is after nine, and says the refuges will be skipped tonight. The remaining instructions are to pass the chant books back, straighten the cushions and leave them in a neat row, and gather in the lobby. The transcript holds nothing of the Bodhisattva Path talk itself.
topics: There is no dharma talk provided
only a passage that appears to be a humorous anecdote about ending a meditation session early due to time.
